messages:
Jae: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete owners for the alert cleanup. focus areas: noise suppression, threshold recalibration, and paging policy.
Marta: I can take noise suppression (grouping/dedupe rules) and will pair with infra to validate silence periods.
Liam: I'll own threshold recalibration. plan: collect 14d baselines, set warning+page tiers, and run chaos tests in staging.
infra-bot: created ticket ONCALL-9987 assigned to Marta, ONCALL-9988 assigned to Liam. Links: https://redwood/ONCALL-9987, https://redwood/ONCALL-9988
Marta: proposal for dedupe: use group_by labels [service, region] + group_interval: 10m and repeat_interval: 30m; also add a pre-filter to drop identical messages within 2m for same origin instance. I'll draft PR early next week.
Liam: thresholds: set warning at mean+2stddev, page at mean+5stddev as a starting point. Will add hysteresis: require 2 evals in 5m to page. Will push a job to compute baselines and share numbers by Tue.
Jae: timeline: Marta due 2026-04-07, Liam due 2026-04-14. weekly check-ins Thu 09:30 PT.
Marta: edgecase: recurring pattern is autoscaler churn in eu-central causing transient 503s during scale events. For those, we should tag metrics with "scale_event=true" and exclude from alerting for 3m.
Liam: agree. I'll add a flag to the anomaly detector so scale_event-tagged metrics map to warning-only for now.
pagerduty-bot: temporary silencing: Applied 3h silence to "kv-cache-5xx" for engineering rotation test.
Marta: I'll add a short-running canary: enable dedupe in staging for one service, monitor pager volume. If drop >60% in duplicates, widen rollout.
Liam: also recommend adding a dashboard with dedupe rate and unique alert counts so we measure impact.
Jae: please add owner fields to the postmortem follow-up table and set the due dates. I'll create calendar invites for the weekly sync. Keep updates to the ticket comments only (one place of truth). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
